examples.chinese: 我不太會用這個牌子的電腦，你可以教我嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài huì yòng zhège páizi de diànnǎo, nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
examples.english: I don't really know how to use this brand of computer; can you teach me?

examples.chinese: 我們班只能禮拜一跟禮拜二下午用。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bān zhǐ néng lǐbài yī gēn lǐbài èr xiàwǔ yòng.
examples.english: Our class can only use it in the afternoon on Mondays and Tuesdays.

examples.chinese: 太好了！在那裡看書很舒服。我們每天都能用那間教室嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Zài nàlǐ kànshū hěn shūfu. Wǒmen měi tiān dōu néng yòng nà jiān jiàoshì ma?
examples.english: That’s awesome! Studying there is very comfortable. Can we use it every day?

examples.chinese: 聽說下星期一我們要用別的教室，你知道是哪間教室嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō xià xīngqīyī wǒmen yào yòng bié de jiàoshì, nǐ zhīdào shì nǎ jiān jiàoshì ma?
examples.english: I heard that next Monday we will use a different classroom; do you know which classroom it is?

examples.chinese: 我常常用中文給台灣朋友寫信。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng yòng Zhōngwén gěi Táiwān péngyǒu xiě xìn.
examples.english: I often write letters to Taiwanese friends in Chinese.

examples.chinese: 華人用十二生肖代表每一年。他常常代表學校去參加游泳比賽，所以在學校非常有名。
examples.pinyin: Huárén yòng shí'èr shēngxiào dàibiǎo měi yì nián. Tā chángcháng dàibiǎo xuéxiào qù cānjiā yóuyǒng bǐsài, suǒyǐ zài xuéxiào fēicháng yǒumíng.
examples.english: Chinese people use the twelve zodiac signs to represent each year. He often represents the school to participate in swimming competitions, so he is very famous at school.

examples.chinese: 小馬先用手機把要賣的商品全部都拍了下來，再放到網路上賣，一個星期就賣完了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ xiān yòng shǒujī bǎ yào mài de shāngpǐn quánbù dōu pāi le xiàlái, zài fàng dào wǎnglù shàng mài, yī ge xīngqī jiù mài wán le.
examples.english: Xiao Ma first used his cell phone to photograph all the products he wanted to sell, then put them online to sell, and they were sold out in a week.

examples.chinese: 追求學問就是要多用腦，不斷地學，不斷地問。
examples.pinyin: Zhuīqiú xuéwèn jiùshì yào duō yòng nǎo, bùduàn de xué, bùduàn de wèn.
examples.english: Pursuing learning means using your brain more, constantly learning, and constantly asking questions.

examples.chinese: 想要得到好成績，除了努力用功，還得學習怎麼利用網路資源。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào dédào hǎo chéngjī, chúle nǔlì yònggōng, hái děi xuéxí zěnme lìyòng wǎnglù zīyuán.
examples.english: If you want to get good grades, besides working hard, you also need to learn how to use online resources.

examples.chinese: 現在大家都習慣用手機照相，一般的相機已經越來越少人使用了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài dàjiā dōu xíguàn yòng shǒujī zhàoxiàng, yìbān de xiàngjī yǐjīng yuèláiyuè shǎo rén shǐyòng le.
examples.english: Nowadays everyone is used to using their cell phones to take pictures; fewer and fewer people use regular cameras.

examples.chinese: 這整條街都是賣體育用品的店，只要來這裡就能買到想要的運動鞋。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhěng tiáo jiē dōu shì mài tǐyù yòngpǐn de diàn, zhǐyào lái zhèlǐ jiù néng mǎi dào xiǎng yào de yùndòng xié.
examples.english: This entire street is full of stores selling sports supplies; as long as you come here, you can buy the athletic shoes you want.

examples.chinese: 公司進了各式各樣的健身機器， 我們得好好利用這些機器，訓練自己的體力。美美剛進模特兒公司時，有一位導演找她演戲，沒想到就讓她變成了有名的明星。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jìn le gèshì-gèyàng de jiànshēn jīqì, wǒmen děi hǎohǎo lìyòng zhèxiē jīqì, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì. Měiměi gāng jìn mótè'ér gōngsī shí, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn zhǎo tā yǎn xì, méi xiǎngdào jiù ràng tā biàn chéng le yǒumíng de míngxīng.
examples.english: The company purchased various kinds of fitness machines; we must make good use of these machines to train our physical strength. When Meimei first entered the modeling agency, a director asked her to act in a show; unexpectedly, it made her a famous star.

examples.chinese: 周先生買了一套用真皮做的沙發，坐起來很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu xiānsheng mǎi le yī tào yòng zhēnpí zuò de shāfā, zuò qǐlái hěn shūfu.
examples.english: Mr. Zhou bought a set of sofas made of genuine leather; they are very comfortable to sit on.

examples.chinese: 我烤了很多巧克力餅乾，用好看的紙包了一些送給鄰居。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kǎo le hěn duō qiǎokèlì bǐnggān, yòng hǎokàn de zhǐ bāo le yìxiē sòng gěi línjū.
examples.english: I baked a lot of chocolate cookies and packed some in pretty paper to give to my neighbors.

examples.chinese: 爺爺在這棟公寓住了十年了，搬家時，用了好幾個大箱子來裝東西。
examples.pinyin: Yéye zài zhè dòng gōngyù zhù le shí nián le, bānjiā shí, yòng le hǎo jǐ ge dà xiāngzi lái zhuāng dōngxi.
examples.english: Grandpa has lived in this apartment building for ten years; when moving, he used several large boxes to pack things.

examples.chinese: 經理這次願意採用新員工的建議，讓我們都嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ zhè cì yuànyì cǎiyòng xīn yuángōng de jiànyì, ràng wǒmen dōu xià le yí tiào.
examples.english: The manager is willing to adopt the new employee's suggestion this time, which gave us all a start.

examples.chinese: 那所雙語學校強調，除了中文課以外，其他的課程都是用英文上的。
examples.pinyin: Nà suǒ shuāngyǔ xuéxiào qiángdiào, chúle Zhōngwén kè yǐwài, qítā de kèchéng dōu shì yòng Yīngwén shàng de.
examples.english: That bilingual school emphasizes that, except for Chinese classes, all other courses are taught in English.

examples.chinese: 付錢的時候，他從皮包裡抽出一張信用卡交給店員。他參加百貨公司的活動，抽到一台價格六萬元的平板電腦， 真是太幸運了！
examples.pinyin: Fù qián de shíhou, tā cóng píbāo lǐ chōu chū yī zhāng xìnyòngkǎ jiāo gěi diànyuán. Tā cānjiā bǎihuò gōngsī de huódòng, chōu dào yī tái jiàgé liù wàn yuán de píngbǎn diànnǎo, zhēn shì tài xìngyùn le!
examples.english: When paying, he took out a credit card from his wallet and handed it to the clerk. He participated in a department store event and drew a tablet computer worth 60,000 yuan; he was really so lucky!

examples.chinese: 我的錢包丟了，裡面有護照、 信用卡，這件事很要緊，得馬上告訴警察。A:你怎麼一直咳嗽？要不要去看醫生？ B:不要緊，我吃過藥了，休息一下就好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo diū le, lǐmiàn yǒu hùzhào, xìnyòngkǎ, zhè jiàn shì hěn yàojǐn, děi mǎshàng gàosu jǐngchá. A: Nǐ zěnme yīzhí késòu? Yào bùyào qù kàn yīshēng? B: Bù yàojǐn, wǒ chī guò yào le, xiūxi yīxià jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: I lost my wallet; inside were my passport and credit card. This matter is very important; I must tell the police immediately. A: Why do you keep coughing? Do you want to see a doctor? B: It's not important; I've taken medicine, and I'll be fine after a little rest.

examples.chinese: 現在的科技很進步，萬一迷了路，就可以利用網路地圖找到回家的路。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de kējì hěn jìnbù, wànyī mí le lù, jiù kěyǐ lìyòng wǎnglù dìtú zhǎo dào huí jiā de lù.
examples.english: Technology is very advanced now; in case you get lost, you can use online maps to find the way home.

examples.chinese: 軍人用卡車把食物和生活用品送到災區，發給需要的民眾。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén yòng kǎchē bǎ shíwù hé shēnghuó yòngpǐn sòng dào zāiqū, fā gěi xūyào de mínzhòng.
examples.english: Soldiers used trucks to deliver food and daily necessities to the disaster area and distribute them to the people in need.

examples.chinese: A: 現在的科技提供非常好用的網路服務，而且很多都是免費的。 B: 好用倒是好用，可是萬一沒有網路，就什麼都做不了了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiànzài de kējì tígōng fēicháng hǎoyòng de wǎnglù fúwù, érqiě hěnduō dōu shì miǎnfèi de. B: Hǎoyòng dàoshì hǎoyòng, kěshì wànyī méiyǒu wǎnglù, jiù shénme dōu zuò bù liǎo le.
examples.english: A: Today's technology provides very easy-to-use internet services, and many are free. B: Sure, it's easy to use, but if there's no internet, then you can't do anything.

examples.chinese: 那個工人使用工廠的機器時，不小心發生了意外，流了很多血。
examples.pinyin: Nàge gōngrén shǐyòng gōngchǎng de jīqì shí, bù xiǎoxīn fāshēng le yìwài, liú le hěn duō xiě.
examples.english: When that worker was using the factory machine, an accident happened accidentally, and he bled a lot.

examples.chinese: 珍珍每天大約看兩個小時的臺灣連續劇，目的是要(訓)練自己的中文聽力。大雄常利用週末練(習)書法，所以漢字寫得比其他同學都好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhēn měitiān dàyuē kàn liǎng ge xiǎoshí de Táiwān liánxùjù, mùdì shì yào xùnliàn zìjǐ de Zhōngwén tīnglì. Dàxióng cháng lìyòng zhōumò liànxí shūfǎ, suǒyǐ Hànzì xiě de bǐ qítā tóngxué dōu hǎokàn.
examples.english: Zhenzhen watches about two hours of Taiwanese TV dramas every day; her purpose is to train her Chinese listening comprehension. Daxiong often uses his weekends to practice calligraphy, so he writes Chinese characters more beautifully than any of his classmates.

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: 這個平板的使用說明寫得很詳細，客人自己看就能明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège píngbǎn de shǐyòng shuōmíng xiě de hěn xiángxì, kèrén zìjǐ kàn jiù néng míngbai le.
examples.english: The user manual for this tablet is written in great detail; customers can understand it just by reading it themselves.

examples.chinese: 我奶奶不會用電腦，每次想跟朋友連絡，不是去郵局寄信就是打家裡的電話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai bú huì yòng diànnǎo, měi cì xiǎng gēn péngyǒu liánluò, bú shì qù yóujú jì xìn jiù shì dǎ jiālǐ de diànhuà.
examples.english: My grandmother doesn't know how to use a computer. Every time she wants to contact her friends, she either goes to the post office to mail a letter or calls the home phone.

examples.chinese: 臺灣護照比以前好用得多，去許多國家旅行都不需要簽證了。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān hùzhào bǐ yǐqián hǎoyòng de duō, qù xǔduō guójiā lǚxíng dōu bù xūyào qiānzhèng le.
examples.english: A Taiwan passport is much more useful than before; when traveling to many countries, you don't need a visa anymore.

examples.chinese: 「了」這個詞的用法可以代表事情完成或情況改變。
examples.pinyin: 「le」 zhège cí de yòngfǎ kěyǐ dàibiǎo shìqíng wánchéng huò qíngkuàng gǎibiàn.
examples.english: The usage of the word 'le' can represent the completion of an action or a change in situation.

examples.chinese: 刷卡購物時，店員會先確認你的簽名是不是和信用卡上的相同。
examples.pinyin: Shuākǎ gòuwù shí, diànyuán huì xiān quèrèn nǐ de qiānmíng shì bùshì hé xìnyòngkǎ shàng de xiāngtóng.
examples.english: When paying by credit card, the clerk will first confirm whether your signature is the same as the one on the credit card.

examples.chinese: 像衝浪、滑雪那樣的戶外活動，又刺激又好玩，不用說，絕對能吸引青少年。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng chōnglàng, huáxuě nàyàng de hùwài huódòng, yòu cìjī yòu hǎowán, bùyòng shuō, juéduì néng xīyǐn qīngshàonián.
examples.english: Outdoor activities like surfing and skiing are both exciting and fun; needless to say, they can definitely attract teenagers.

examples.chinese: 父母要經常陪孩子聊天、玩遊戲，給零用錢不能完全滿足孩子的需要。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yào jīngcháng péi háizi liáotiān, wán yóuxì, gěi língyòngqián bù néng wánquán mǎnzú háizi de xūyào.
examples.english: Parents should often chat and play games with their children; giving pocket money cannot completely satisfy children's needs.

examples.chinese: 這家超市賣的商品都是安全的，讓顧客買得安心、吃得安心，用的也安心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshì mài de shāngpǐn dōu shì ānquán de, ràng gùkè mǎi de ānxīn, chī de ānxīn, yòng de yě ānxīn.
examples.english: The products sold at this supermarket are all safe, allowing customers to buy with peace of mind, eat with peace of mind, and use with peace of mind.

examples.chinese: 越來越多人使用網路上課，所以手機、電腦也就變成了重要的學習工具。
examples.pinyin: Yuèláiyuè duō rén shǐyòng wǎnglù shàngkè, suǒyǐ shǒujī, diànnǎo yě jiù biànchéng le zhòngyào de xuéxí gōngjù.
examples.english: More and more people use the Internet for classes, so mobile phones and computers have also become important learning tools.

examples.chinese: 這個教材比較難，老師怕學生不容易吸收，因此利用各種教學工具來幫助學生學習。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàocái bǐjiào nán, lǎoshī pà xuéshēng bù róngyì xīshōu, yīncǐ lìyòng gè zhǒng jiàoxué gōngjù lái bāngzhù xuéshēng xuéxí.
examples.english: This textbook is rather difficult; the teacher was afraid students wouldn't easily absorb it, therefore used various teaching tools to help students learn.

examples.chinese: 我爺爺年紀大了，不但體力不好，還有頭痛、肩膀痛的毛病。我家的洗衣機用了二十多年了，毛病真不少，可是媽媽還不肯換新的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye niánjì dà le, bùdàn tǐlì bù hǎo, hái yǒu tóutòng, jiānbǎng tòng de máobìng. Wǒ jiā de xǐyījī yòng le èrshí duō nián le, máobìng zhēn bù shǎo, kěshì māma hái bù kěn huàn xīn de.
examples.english: My grandpa is old; not only is his physical strength poor, but he also has the problem of headaches and shoulder pain. Our washing machine has been used for over twenty years and has quite a few problems, but Mom still won't agree to replace it with a new one.

examples.chinese: 張太太一個人管三個孩子，家裡大大小小的事情也是她負責的，太辛苦了。姊姊：下個星期就要大學考試了，你怎麼不用功念書，反而天天出去玩？ 弟弟：妳別管我，這是我自己的事。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai yī gè rén guǎn sān gè háizi, jiālǐ dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng yě shì tā fùzé de, tài xīngkǔ le. Jiějie: Xià gè xīngqī jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, nǐ zěnme bù yònggōng niànshū, fǎn'ér tiāntiān chūqù wán? Dìdi: Nǐ bié guǎn wǒ, zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ de shì.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang manages three children all by herself, and she is also responsible for all the big and small matters at home; it's too hard. Older sister: The university exam is next week; why aren't you studying hard, but instead going out to play every day? Younger brother: Don't manage me; this is my own business.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風引起的水災太嚴重，害大家一連五天沒有乾淨的水可以用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǐnqǐ de shuǐzāi tài yánzhòng, hài dàjiā yīlián wǔ tiān méiyǒu gānjìng de shuǐ kěyǐ yòng.
examples.english: The flood caused by this typhoon was too serious, causing everyone to go five days in a row without clean water to use.

examples.chinese: 王小姐用網路交友的方式，找到了理想的結婚對象。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiǎojiě yòng wǎnglù jiāoyǒu de fāngshì, zhǎodàole lǐxiǎng de jiéhūn duìxiàng.
examples.english: Miss Wang used the method of making friends online and found her ideal marriage partner.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方不算偏僻，但是附近沒有公車站，所以自行車成了我最常利用的交通工具。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng bù suàn piānpì, dànshì fùjìn méiyǒu gōngchēzhàn, suǒyǐ zìxíngchē chéng le wǒ zuì cháng lìyòng de jiāotōng gōngjù.
examples.english: The place I live is not considered remote, but there is no bus stop nearby, so the bicycle has become the transportation tool I use most often.

examples.chinese: 這部電影是用真實故事拍成的，讓觀眾感覺很真實，也很感動。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shì yòng zhēnshí gùshì pāi chéng de, ràng guānzhòng gǎnjué hěn zhēnshí, yě hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: This movie was made based on a real story, making the audience feel it is very real and also very moved.

examples.chinese: 我等一下要開會，不方便接電話，有事就用手機傳訊息給我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ děng yīxià yào kāihuì, bù fāngbiàn jiē diànhuà, yǒu shì jiù yòng shǒujī chuán xùnxí gěi wǒ.
examples.english: I have a meeting in a little while, so it's not convenient to answer the phone; if there's anything, just send me a message on my cell phone.

examples.chinese: 以電腦系統取代傳統收停車費的方式，能幫老闆節省工作人員的費用。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ diànnǎo xìtǒng qǔdài chuántǒng shōu tíngchē fèi de fāngshì, néng bāng lǎobǎn jiéshěng gōngzuò rényuán de fèiyòng.
examples.english: Replacing the traditional method of collecting parking fees with a computer system can help the boss save on staff costs.

examples.chinese: 網路商店滿足了人們購物的需求，就是不出門，也可買到各式各樣的生活用品。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn mǎnzú le rénmen gòuwù de xūqiú, jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě mǎi dào gè shì gè yàng de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
examples.english: Online stores have satisfied people's shopping needs; even without leaving home, you can buy all kinds of daily necessities.

examples.chinese: 古先生很重視環保，購物時會準備環保袋，在餐廳吃飯也會用環保筷。
examples.pinyin: Gǔ xiānsheng hěn zhòngshì huánbǎo, gòuwù shí huì zhǔnbèi huánbǎo dài, zài cāntīng chīfàn yě huì yòng huánbǎo kuài.
examples.english: Mr. Gu attaches great importance to environmental protection; when shopping he prepares eco-friendly bags, and when eating in restaurants he also uses eco-friendly chopsticks.

examples.chinese: 國家圖書館和博物館都是公共資源，任何人都可以使用。
examples.pinyin: Guójiā túshūguǎn hé bówùguǎn dōu shì gōnggòng zīyuán, rènhé rén dōu kěyǐ shǐyòng.
examples.english: National libraries and museums are public resources that anyone can use.

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: 媽媽實在太會做飯了，只用了一個小時就變出一桌既豐富又好吃的大餐。
examples.pinyin: Māma shízài tài huì zuòfàn le, zhǐ yòng le yí ge xiǎoshí jiù biàn chū yì zhuō jì fēngfù yòu hǎochī de dàcān.
examples.english: Mom is really too good at cooking; in just one hour, she conjured up a table full of both abundant and delicious feast.

examples.chinese: 《生日快樂》是全世界著名的歌曲，不同國家的人也能用自己的語言唱出來。
examples.pinyin: 《Shēngrì Kuàilè》 shì quán shìjiè zhùmíng de gēqǔ, bùtóng guójiā de rén yě néng yòng zìjǐ de yǔyán chàng chūlái.
examples.english: "Happy Birthday" is a world-famous song; people from different countries can also sing it in their own languages.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己的語言和文字，也用它們來記錄歷史。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ de yǔyán hé wénzì, yě yòng tāmen lái jìlù lìshǐ.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own language and writing, and also uses them to record history.

examples.chinese: 孩子是父母最親愛的寶貝，父母對他們的愛是沒辦法用文字來形容的。
examples.pinyin: Háizi shì fùmǔ zuì qīn'ài de bǎobèi, fùmǔ duì tāmen de ài shì méi bànfǎ yòng wénzì lái xíngróng de.
examples.english: Children are their parents' most beloved treasures; parents' love for them cannot be described in words.

examples.chinese: 博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin: 1. Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de. 2. Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english: 1. The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money. 2. Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

examples.chinese: 使用地球資源和保護地球環境是相對的，資源使用得越多，環境就越需要被保護。
examples.pinyin: Shǐyòng dìqiú zīyuán hé bǎohù dìqiú huánjìng shì xiāngduì de, zīyuán shǐyòng de yuè duō, huánjìng jiù yuè xūyào bèi bǎohù.
examples.english: Using Earth's resources and protecting Earth's environment are relative: the more resources are used, the more the environment needs to be protected.

examples.chinese: 打破你們的碗盤是我的錯，我會對自己的行為負責，付你們這個費用。
examples.pinyin: Dǎpò nǐmen de wǎnpán shì wǒ de cuò, wǒ huì duì zìjǐ de xíngwéi fùzé, fù nǐmen zhège fèiyòng.
examples.english: Breaking your dishes was my fault; I will take responsibility for my behavior and pay you this fee.

examples.chinese: 今天客人跟著小溫去參觀工廠，也試用了新產品，一切安排都令他十分滿意。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kèrén gēnzhe Xiǎo Wēn qù cānguān gōngchǎng, yě shìyòng le xīn chǎnpǐn, yīqiè ānpái dōu lìng tā shífēn mǎnyì.
examples.english: Today the guests followed Xiao Wen to visit the factory and also tried out new products; all the arrangements made him very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 華人用不一樣的動物代表每一年，一共有十二種動物。
examples.pinyin: Huárén yòng bù yíyàng de dòngwù dàibiǎo měi yì nián, yígòng yǒu shí'èr zhǒng dòngwù.
examples.english: Chinese use different animals to represent each year, and there are a total of twelve kinds of animals.

items.wordHook: Inside a 冂(frame) sit 二(two) bars → grab them to 用(use).

items.key: ["B1L09-2-15","语言交换","語言交換","语言交换","Ph"]

examples.chinese: 可是這些時間我都有語言交換，不能去。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì zhèxiē shíjiān wǒ dōu yǒu yǔyán jiāohuàn, bù néng qù.
examples.english: But I will be doing language exchange during that time. I can’t make it.

examples.chinese: 現在我非常忙，沒有很多時間讀書，可是因為有語言交換，所以我的中文進步了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ fēicháng máng, méi yǒu hěn duō shíjiān dúshū, kěshì yīnwèi yǒu yǔyán jiāohuàn, suǒyǐ wǒ de Zhōngwén jìnbù le.
examples.english: Nowadays, I am very busy; I don’t have much time for studying. However, because of language exchange, I have improved (my Chinese) a lot.

examples.chinese: 這個公園裡有幾棵又高又大的樹。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge gōngyuán lǐ yǒu jǐ kē yòu gāo yòu dà de shù.
examples.english: In this park there are several tall and big trees.

examples.chinese: 童先生穿著一件綠色的襯衫，配上一條咖啡色的褲子，看起來真像一棵樹。
examples.pinyin: Tóng xiānsheng chuānzhe yī jiàn lǜsè de chènshān, pèi shàng yī tiáo kāfēisè de kùzi, kàn qǐlái zhēn xiàng yī kē shù.
examples.english: Mr. Tong is wearing a green shirt, matched with a brown pair of pants; he really looks like a tree.

examples.chinese: 那位老先生走著走著，路旁的樹木突然倒了下來，他差一點就受傷了。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo xiānshēng zǒuzhe zǒuzhe, lù páng de shùmù tūrán dǎo le xiàlái, tā chà yīdiǎn jiù shòushāng le.
examples.english: That elderly gentleman was walking and walking, when suddenly the trees beside the road fell down; he was almost injured.

examples.chinese: 這個地區被颱風破壞得相當嚴重，不是樹木倒了，就是屋頂被吹走了，情況非常糟糕。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bèi táifēng pòhuài de xiāngdāng yánzhòng, bùshì shùmù dǎo le, jiùshì wūdǐng bèi chuī zǒu le, qíngkuàng fēicháng zāogāo.
examples.english: This area was damaged quite severely by the typhoon; either trees fell down or roofs were blown away—the situation is very bad.

examples.chinese: 茶樹的葉子沒有被破壞的話，做出來的茶葉品質都比較好。
examples.pinyin: Cháshù de yèzi méiyǒu bèi pòhuài de huà, zuò chūlái de cháyè pǐnzhì dōu bǐjiào hǎo.
examples.english: If the leaves of the tea tree have not been damaged, the quality of the tea leaves produced is generally better.

examples.chinese: 這個山區種了許多茶樹，到了收穫季節，就會有一群採茶姑娘上山採茶。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shānqū zhòng le xǔduō cháshù, dào le shōuhuò jìjié, jiù huì yǒu yī qún cǎi chá gūniang shàngshān cǎi chá.
examples.english: Many tea trees are planted in this mountainous area; when the harvest season comes, a group of tea-picking girls will go up the mountain to pick tea.

examples.chinese: 我國四季都有美麗的風景：春季時平原有花海、夏季時海灘有日出、秋季時山區有紅樹、冬季時高山有白雪，都十分迷人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ guó sìjì dōu yǒu měilì de fēngjǐng: chūnjì shí píngyuán yǒu huāhǎi, xiàjì shí hǎitān yǒu rìchū, qiūjì shí shānqū yǒu hóngshù, dōngjì shí gāoshān yǒu báixuě, dōu shífēn mírén.
examples.english: Our country has beautiful scenery in all four seasons: in spring, the plains have seas of flowers; in summer, the beaches have sunrises; in autumn, the mountains have red trees; in winter, the high mountains have white snow—all are very charming.

examples.chinese: 今天光是整理前院的花草樹木就讓我累得要命，只好明天再整理後院了。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān guāng shì zhěnglǐ qiányuàn de huācǎo shùmù jiù ràng wǒ lèi de yàomìng, zhǐhǎo míngtiān zài zhěnglǐ hòuyuàn le.
examples.english: Today, just tidying up the flowers, plants, and trees in the front yard made me extremely tired, so I'll have to do the backyard tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 阿里山上的樹木又高又粗，好幾棵樹木的年齡都超過一千年了。
examples.pinyin: Ālǐshān shàng de shùmù yòu gāo yòu cū, hǎojǐ kē shùmù de niánlíng dōu chāoguò yīqiān nián le.
examples.english: The trees on Alishan are both tall and thick; several of them are over a thousand years old.

examples.chinese: A:你要不要跟我一起去茶館喝杯茶？ B:與其去喝茶，我倒想去外面走走，看看花草樹木。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ yào bù yào gēn wǒ yīqǐ qù cháguǎn hē bēi chá? B: Yǔqí qù hē chá, wǒ dào xiǎng qù wàimiàn zǒuzǒu, kànkan huā cǎo shùmù.
examples.english: A: Do you want to go to the teahouse with me to have a cup of tea? B: Rather than go drink tea, I'd actually like to go for a walk outside and look at the flowers, grass, and trees.

examples.chinese: 我跟室友的個性、興趣都差不多，所以我們是好朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn shìyǒu de gèxìng, xìngqù dōu chàbuduō, suǒyǐ wǒmen shì hǎo péngyou.
examples.english: My roommate and I are similar in personality and interests, so we are good friends.

examples.chinese: 林小姐弄錯了約會的時間，所以遲到了半個小時。我覺得「害怕」跟「可怕」的意思差不多，所以常弄錯。
examples.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě nòngcuò le yuēhuì de shíjiān, suǒyǐ chídào le bàn ge xiǎoshí. Wǒ juéde “hàipà” gēn “kěpà” de yìsi chàbuduō, suǒyǐ cháng nòngcuò.
examples.english: Miss Lin made a mistake about the appointment time, so she was half an hour late. I think “afraid” and “scary” have similar meanings, so I often misunderstand.

examples.chinese: 我的房租每個月一萬塊，加上水費、電費，差不多一萬三。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fángzū měi gè yuè yī wàn kuài, jiāshàng shuǐfèi, diànfèi, chàbuduō yī wàn sān.
examples.english: My rent is 10,000 dollars a month; plus water and electricity fees, it's about 13,000.

examples.chinese: 他喜歡玩手機遊戲，差不多每天玩兩個小時。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan wán shǒujī yóuxì, chàbuduō měitiān wán liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: He likes to play mobile games, and plays for about two hours almost every day.

examples.chinese: 從中部坐車到南部去，差不多要兩個小時。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhōngbù zuò chē dào nánbù qù, chàbuduō yào liǎng gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Taking a bus from the central part to the southern part takes about two hours.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸是老師，他很喜歡他的工作。他在餐廳工作，每天差不多都晚上十點回家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba shì lǎoshī, tā hěn xǐhuān tā de gōngzuò. Tā zài cāntīng gōngzuò, měitiān chàbuduō dōu wǎnshàng shí diǎn huí jiā.
examples.english: My dad is a teacher; he really likes his job. He works at a restaurant, and he almost always gets home around ten at night every day.

examples.chinese: A:你每天幾點起床？ B:差不多七點。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ měi tiān jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng? B: Chàbuduō qī diǎn.
examples.english: A: What time do you get up every day? B: About seven o'clock.

examples.chinese: 美國的一毛錢差不多是台灣的三塊錢。
examples.pinyin: Měiguó de yī máo qián chàbuduō shì Táiwān de sān kuài qián.
examples.english: One dime in the US is about three dollars in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 台灣的夏天，差不多五點鐘天就亮了。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de xiàtiān, chàbuduō wǔ diǎn zhōng tiān jiù liàng le.
examples.english: In summer in Taiwan, the sky is bright at about five o'clock.

examples.chinese: 去年台灣冬天的溫度很低，差不多五度，冷得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Qùnián Táiwān dōngtiān de wēndù hěn dī, chàbuduō wǔ dù, lěng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Last year, the temperature in Taiwan in winter was very low, about five degrees, and it was extremely cold.

examples.chinese: 我們的成長經驗、教育背景都差不多，所以想法也很像。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de chéngzhǎng jīngyàn, jiàoyù bèijǐng dōu chàbuduō, suǒyǐ xiǎngfǎ yě hěn xiàng.
examples.english: Our upbringing experiences and educational backgrounds are about the same, so our ideas are also very similar.

examples.chinese: 聽說天上的一天，差不多是人間的好幾十年。這裡的風景美極了，好像人間天堂一樣。
examples.pinyin: 1. Tīngshuō tiānshàng de yì tiān, chàbuduō shì rénjiān de hǎo jǐ shí nián. 2. Zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng měi jí le, hǎoxiàng rénjiān tiāntáng yíyàng.
examples.english: 1. I've heard that one day in heaven is about several decades in the human world. 2. The scenery here is extremely beautiful, as if it were a paradise on earth.

items.wordHook: 差(difference) + 不(no) + 多(much): the difference is not much, so it's about/approximately.

examples.chinese: 陳小姐今天穿了一件跟我相同牌子的洋裝，還好顏色不同。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiǎojiě jīntiān chuān le yī jiàn gēn wǒ xiāngtóng páizi de yángzhuāng, hái hǎo yánsè bùtóng.
examples.english: Miss Chen wore a dress of the same brand as mine today; fortunately, the color is different.

examples.chinese: 我今天跟同學穿了樣式不同，但是顏色相同的洋裝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān gēn tóngxué chuān le yàngshì bùtóng, dànshì yánsè xiāngtóng de yángzhuāng.
examples.english: Today my classmate and I wore dresses that are different in style but the same in color.

examples.chinese: 客人看了那件洋裝一眼就走了，應該不喜歡吧。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén kàn le nà jiàn yángzhuāng yì yǎn jiù zǒu le, yīnggāi bù xǐhuān ba.
examples.english: The customer took one glance at that dress and then left; she probably doesn't like it.

examples.chinese: A:對這次新產品的銷售方式，你有什麼想法？ B:我在這方面沒什麼經驗，你可以去請教方經理。
examples.pinyin: A: Duì zhè cì xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu fāngshì, nǐ yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ? B: Wǒ zài zhè fāngmiàn méi shénme jīngyàn, nǐ kěyǐ qù qǐngjiào Fāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: A: Regarding the sales method for this new product, what ideas do you have? B: I don't have much experience in this aspect; you can go ask Manager Fang.

examples.chinese: 那個美國人每天看臺灣的連續劇，一方面學習中文，一方面了解臺灣的生活文化。
examples.pinyin: Nàge Měiguórén měitiān kàn Táiwān de liánxùjù, yìfāngmiàn xuéxí Zhōngwén, yìfāngmiàn liǎojiě Táiwān de shēnghuó wénhuà.
examples.english: That American watches Taiwanese TV series every day: on one hand to learn Chinese, on the other hand to understand Taiwanese life and culture.

examples.chinese: 國家跟國家之間的外交關係很重要，這方面的工作是總統負責的。
examples.pinyin: Guójiā gēn guójiā zhījiān de wàijiāo guānxì hěn zhòngyào, zhè fāngmiàn de gōngzuò shì zǒngtǒng fùzé de.
examples.english: Diplomatic relations between countries are very important; work in this area is the president's responsibility.

examples.chinese: 人類的智慧表現在思考、溝通、欣賞、創造等方面。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi de zhìhuì biǎoxiàn zài sīkǎo, gōutōng, xīnshǎng, chuàngzào děng fāngmiàn.
examples.english: Human wisdom is manifested in aspects such as thinking, communication, appreciation, and creation.

examples.chinese: 歷史系的李教授最近經常接受記者的訪問，因此變得很有名。那名記者為了訪問總統外交、貿易等方面的問題，閱讀了許多相關的資料。
examples.pinyin: Lìshǐ xì de Lǐ jiàoshòu zuìjìn jīngcháng jiēshòu jìzhě de fǎngwèn, yīncǐ biàn de hěn yǒumíng. Nà míng jìzhě wèile fǎngwèn zǒngtǒng wàijiāo, màoyì děng fāngmiàn de wèntí, yuèdú le xǔduō xiāngguān de zīliào.
examples.english: Professor Li from the History Department has recently often been interviewed by reporters, and therefore has become very famous. That reporter, in order to interview the president about questions on diplomacy, trade, and other aspects, read a lot of related materials.

examples.chinese: 從六○年代開始，臺灣就提供農業方面的協助給許多國家，這點讓我覺得很驕傲。
examples.pinyin: Cóng liù○ niándài kāishǐ, Táiwān jiù tígōng nóngyè fāngmiàn de xiézhù gěi xǔduō guójiā, zhè diǎn ràng wǒ juéde hěn jiāo'ào.
examples.english: Starting from the 1960s, Taiwan has provided assistance in agriculture to many countries; this point makes me feel very proud.

examples.chinese: 這兩家公司在科技方面合作了很多年，也在科學雜誌上發表了共同的研究成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiā gōngsī zài kējì fāngmiàn hézuò le hěn duō nián, yě zài kēxué zázhì shàng fābiǎo le gòngtóng de yánjiū chéngguǒ.
examples.english: These two companies have cooperated in technology for many years and have also published mutual research results in science magazines.

examples.chinese: 我老婆最近又忙又累，因此我特地在餐桌上頭擺了她最愛的紅玫瑰，讓她開心一下。為了打開(to open up)國外市場，公司上頭決定增加網路銷售方面的經費。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ lǎopo zuìjìn yòu máng yòu lèi, yīncǐ wǒ tèdì zài cānzhuō shàngtou bǎi le tā zuì ài de hóng méiguī, ràng tā kāixīn yīxià. Wèile dǎkāi guówài shìchǎng, gōngsī shàngtou juédìng zēngjiā wǎnglù xiāoshòu fāngmiàn de jīngfèi.
examples.english: My wife has been both busy and tired recently, so I specially placed her favorite red roses on top of the dining table to cheer her up a bit. In order to open up overseas markets, the company's higher-ups decided to increase funding for online sales.

examples.chinese: 根據目前科學研究的資料，女性與男性在能力、態度和行為等方面的差異都非常小。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù mùqián kēxué yánjiū de zīliào, nǚxìng yǔ nánxìng zài nénglì, tàidù hé xíngwéi děng fāngmiàn de chāyì dōu fēicháng xiǎo.
examples.english: According to current scientific research data, the differences between women and men in aspects such as ability, attitude, and behavior are all very small.

examples.chinese: 我的親戚是數學教授，每次我有這方面的問題就向他請教。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qīnqi shì shùxué jiàoshòu, měi cì wǒ yǒu zhè fāngmiàn de wèntí jiù xiàng tā qǐngjiào.
examples.english: My relative is a math professor; every time I have a question in this area, I consult him.

examples.chinese: 傳統私立高中有許多規定，在管理學生方面相當嚴格。
examples.pinyin: Chuántǒng sīlì gāozhōng yǒu xǔduō guīdìng, zài guǎnlǐ xuéshēng fāngmiàn xiāngdāng yángé.
examples.english: Traditional private high schools have many rules and are quite strict in terms of managing students.

items.wordHook: Combining 方(char) and 面(face): 方面 means aspect.

examples.chinese: 前天的強烈颱風帶來了大雨，很多地方都淹水了。
examples.pinyin: Qiántiān de qiángliè táifēng dài lái le dàyǔ, hěn duō dìfāng dōu yānshuǐ le.
examples.english: The strong typhoon the day before yesterday brought heavy rain, and many places were flooded.

examples.chinese: 春天來了，天氣變暖和了，院子裡開了各種顏色的花，給人帶來一種新的希望。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, tiānqì biàn nuǎnhuo le, yuànzi lǐ kāi le gè zhǒng yánsè de huā, gěi rén dàilái yī zhǒng xīn de xīwàng.
examples.english: Spring has come, the weather has become warmer, and flowers of various colors have blossomed in the yard, bringing people a new kind of hope.

examples.chinese: 你得把保證書帶來，我們才能幫你免費修理電腦。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ děi bǎ bǎozhèngshū dàilái, wǒmen cái néng bāng nǐ miǎnfèi xiūlǐ diànnǎo.
examples.english: You have to bring the warranty, and only then can we help you repair the computer for free.

examples.chinese: 有人設計出地震的警告系統，減少了地震帶來的傷害，這樣的成就真是了不起。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shèjì chū dìzhèn de jǐnggào xìtǒng, jiǎnshǎo le dìzhèn dàilái de shānghài, zhèyàng de chéngjiù zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: Someone designed an earthquake warning system that reduced the damage caused by earthquakes; such an achievement is truly amazing.

examples.chinese: 以前人們常用磁帶來存電腦的重要資料。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián rénmen cháng yòng cídài lái cún diànnǎo de zhòngyào zīliào.
examples.english: In the past, people often used magnetic tape to store important computer data.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風可能帶來大量雨水，地形較低的地區應該多注意。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng kěnéng dàilái dàliàng yǔshuǐ, dìxíng jiào dī de dìqū yīnggāi duō zhùyì.
examples.english: This typhoon may bring a great amount of rain, so areas with lower terrain should pay more attention.

examples.chinese: 購物是一種享受，超過個人需求的消費，卻只會帶來煩惱。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù shì yī zhǒng xiǎngshòu, chāoguò gèrén xūqiú de xiāofèi, què zhǐ huì dàilái fánnǎo.
examples.english: Shopping is a kind of enjoyment, but spending that exceeds personal needs only brings worries.

examples.chinese: 千萬別帶著笨重的行李去旅行，那會給你帶來很多麻煩。
examples.pinyin: Qiānwàn bié dài zhe bènzhòng de xíngli qù lǚxíng, nà huì gěi nǐ dàilái hěnduō máfan.
examples.english: By all means don't travel with heavy, cumbersome luggage; that will bring you a lot of trouble.

examples.chinese: 迷信的人老是相信一些不真實的迷信，例如：黑貓會帶來不好的運氣、送傘給情人就會分手什麼的。
examples.pinyin: Míxìn de rén lǎoshì xiāngxìn yīxiē bù zhēnshí de míxìn, lìrú: hēimāo huì dàilái bù hǎo de yùnqì, sòng sǎn gěi qíngrén jiù huì fēnshǒu shénme de.
examples.english: Superstitious people always believe in some untrue superstitions, for example: black cats will bring bad luck, giving an umbrella to a lover will lead to a breakup, and so on.

examples.chinese: 有時改變原來旅行的安排，可能會帶來不同的樂趣。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushí gǎibiàn yuánlái lǚxíng de ānpái, kěnéng huì dàilái bùtóng de lèqù.
examples.english: Sometimes changing the original travel arrangements may bring different pleasures.

examples.chinese: 只有勇敢面對挑戰、克服困難的人，才能深深體會到成就感帶來的快樂。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu yǒnggǎn miànduì tiǎozhàn, kèfú kùnnán de rén, cái néng shēnshēn tǐhuì dào chéngjiùgǎn dàilái de kuàilè.
examples.english: Only those who bravely face challenges and overcome difficulties can deeply experience the happiness that a sense of accomplishment brings.

examples.chinese: 與鄰居建立友好的關係，能為你帶來很多好處。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ línjū jiànlì yǒuhǎo de guānxì, néng wèi nǐ dàilái hěn duō hǎochù.
examples.english: Establishing friendly relations with neighbors can bring you many benefits.

examples.chinese: 假如人人都發揮人性美好的一面，就能給社會帶來和平。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú rénrén dōu fāhuī rénxìng měihǎo de yī miàn, jiù néng gěi shèhuì dàilái hépíng.
examples.english: If everyone brings out the beautiful side of human nature, then it can bring peace to society.

items.wordHook: To 帶(belt) a 來(arrive): 帶來 means bring.

examples.chinese: 父母對孩子表現的肯定，就是給孩子最好的鼓勵。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ duì háizi biǎoxiàn de kěndìng, jiùshì gěi háizi zuì hǎo de gǔlì.
examples.english: Parents' affirmation of their children's performance is the best encouragement for the children.

examples.chinese: 百貨公司經常辦活動及送贈品，都是為了鼓勵客人多消費。
examples.pinyin: Bǎihuò gōngsī jīngcháng bàn huódòng jí sòng zèngpǐn, dōu shì wèile gǔlì kèrén duō xiāofèi.
examples.english: Department stores often hold events and give away free gifts, all to encourage customers to spend more.

examples.chinese: 當別人表現得很好時，別忘了為他們鼓掌，給他們鼓勵。
examples.pinyin: Dāng biérén biǎoxiàn de hěn hǎo shí, bié wàngle wèi tāmen gǔzhǎng, gěi tāmen gǔlì.
examples.english: When others perform well, don't forget to applaud for them and give them encouragement.

examples.chinese: 有朋友與家人的鼓勵，使他在面對任何困難時都十分自信。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu péngyǒu yǔ jiārén de gǔlì, shǐ tā zài miànduì rènhé kùnnán shí dōu shífēn zìxìn.
examples.english: With the encouragement of friends and family, he is very confident when facing any difficulty.

examples.chinese: 學校書法比賽的獎品是一臺平板電腦，希望能鼓勵大家參加。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào shūfǎ bǐsài de jiǎngpǐn shì yì tái píngbǎn diànnǎo, xīwàng néng gǔlì dàjiā cānjiā.
examples.english: The prize for the school calligraphy competition is a tablet computer, hoping to encourage everyone to participate.

examples.chinese: 過年時什麼都漲，連搭計程車的時候，車費都漲價了。
examples.pinyin: Guònián shí shénme dōu zhǎng, lián dā jìchéngchē de shíhou, chēfèi dōu zhǎngjià le.
examples.english: During Chinese New Year everything goes up in price; even when taking a taxi, the fare has increased.

examples.chinese: 自從政府宣布石油、電費雙漲的作法以來，反對的民眾人數已近七成。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng zhèngfǔ xuānbù shíyóu, diànfèi shuāng zhǎng de zuòfǎ yǐlái, fǎnduì de mínzhòng rénshù yǐ jìn qī chéng.
examples.english: Since the government announced the policy of raising both oil and electricity prices, the number of people opposed has approached seventy percent.

examples.chinese: 你看，他們在跳舞，跳得真好看！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, tāmen zài tiàowǔ, tiào de zhēn hǎokàn!
examples.english: Look, they are dancing; they dance really beautifully!

examples.chinese: 他的舞跳得很好。
examples.pinyin: Tā de wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: He dances very well.

items.wordHook: a 𠂉(lying person) holds 卌(forty) ribbons and 一(one) steady beat as 舛(crossed feet) cross → the 舞(dance).

examples.chinese: 國王命下面的人死，那些人就非死不可。
examples.pinyin: Guówáng mìng xiàmiàn de rén sǐ, nàxiē rén jiù fēi sǐ bùkě.
examples.english: If the king ordered the people below to die, those people had no choice but to die.

examples.chinese: 在古代，國王所說的話是絕對的，也是最高的命令。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, guówáng suǒ shuō de huà shì juéduì de, yě shì zuì gāo de mìnglìng.
examples.english: In ancient times, what the king said was absolute and also the highest command.

examples.chinese: 那位母親寧可犧牲自己的生命，也要保護孩子的安全。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi mǔqīn nìngkě xīshēng zìjǐ de shēngmìng, yě yào bǎohù háizi de ānquán.
examples.english: That mother would rather sacrifice her own life to protect her child's safety.

examples.chinese: 生命就像一片海洋，有時穩定有時瘋狂。
examples.pinyin: Shēngmìng jiù xiàng yī piàn hǎiyáng, yǒushí wěndìng yǒushí fēngkuáng.
examples.english: Life is like an ocean, sometimes stable and sometimes crazy.

examples.chinese: 生命就像海洋一樣，只有勇敢的人們才能抵達海的另一邊。
examples.pinyin: Shēngmìng jiù xiàng hǎiyáng yíyàng, zhǐyǒu yǒnggǎn de rénmen cái néng dǐdá hǎi de lìng yì biān.
examples.english: Life is like the ocean; only brave people can reach the other side of the sea.

examples.chinese: 我們無法決定生命的長度，卻能夠決定生活的品質。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wúfǎ juédìng shēngmìng de chángdù, què nénggòu juédìng shēnghuó de pǐnzhì.
examples.english: We cannot decide the length of life, but we can decide the quality of life.

examples.chinese: 理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng. Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation. The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 誰都無法告訴你生命的意義是什麼，只能自己去尋找答案。
examples.pinyin: Shéi dōu wúfǎ gàosù nǐ shēngmìng de yìyì shì shénme, zhǐ néng zìjǐ qù xúnzhǎo dá'àn.
examples.english: No one is able to tell you what the meaning of life is; you can only search for the answer yourself.

examples.chinese: 博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin: 1. Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de. 2. Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english: 1. The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money. 2. Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

examples.chinese: 打仗期間，許多軍人為國家犧牲了寶貴的生命，也給家人留下了痛苦的記憶。
examples.pinyin: Dǎzhàng qījiān, xǔduō jūnrén wèi guójiā xīshēngle bǎoguì de shēngmìng, yě gěi jiārén liúxiàle tòngkǔ de jìyì.
examples.english: During the war, many soldiers sacrificed their precious lives for the country, and also left painful memories for their families.

examples.chinese: 強烈颱風快來了，救災中心對民眾發出警告，為了自己的生命安全，絕對別去海邊。小游經常喝了酒還開車回家，太太警告他如果不改掉這個壞習慣，就要跟他離婚。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè táifēng kuài lái le, jiùzāi zhōngxīn duì mínzhòng fāchū jǐnggào, wèile zìjǐ de shēngmìng ānquán, juéduì bié qù hǎibiān. Xiǎo Yóu jīngcháng hē le jiǔ hái kāichē huí jiā, tàitai jǐnggào tā rúguǒ bù gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn, jiù yào gēn tā líhūn.
examples.english: A strong typhoon is coming soon; the disaster relief center issued a warning to the public: for your own safety, absolutely do not go to the beach. Xiao You often drives home after drinking; his wife warned him that if he doesn't change this bad habit, she will divorce him.

examples.chinese: 這個紀念堂是為了紀念那些為國家犧牲生命的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìniàntáng shì wèile jìniàn nàxiē wèi guójiā xīshēng shēngmìng de jūnrén.
examples.english: This memorial hall is to commemorate those soldiers who sacrificed their lives for the country.

examples.chinese: 沒有人知道自己的命能有多長， 所以每天都應該好好過日子。不少人相信人的命是被決定的， 誰都改變不了。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén zhīdào zìjǐ de mìng néng yǒu duō cháng, suǒyǐ měi tiān dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guò rìzi. Bùshǎo rén xiāngxìn rén de mìng shì bèi juédìng de, shéi dōu gǎibiàn bù liǎo.
examples.english: No one knows how long their own life can be, so every day one should live life well. Many people believe that a person's fate is decided, and no one can change it.

examples.chinese: 醫生的工作是讓病人恢復健康，甚至把寶貴的生命救回來，所以我們應該尊敬醫生。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng de gōngzuò shì ràng bìngrén huīfù jiànkāng, shènzhì bǎ bǎoguì de shēngmìng jiù huílái, suǒyǐ wǒmen yīnggāi zūnjìng yīshēng.
examples.english: A doctor's job is to help patients recover their health, and even to save precious life back, so we should respect doctors.

examples.chinese: 救護車開得很快，因為要救人一命。
examples.pinyin: Jiùhùchē kāi de hěn kuài, yīnwèi yào jiù rén yī mìng.
examples.english: The ambulance drove very fast, because it needed to save a person's life.

examples.chinese: 要是你擔心營養不夠的話，吃點兒維他命對身體健康會有幫助的。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ dānxīn yíngyǎng bù gòu de huà, chī diǎnr wéitāmìng duì shēntǐ jiànkāng huì yǒu bāngzhù de.
examples.english: If you're worried about not getting enough nutrition, taking some vitamins will help your health.

examples.chinese: 今天光是整理前院的花草樹木就讓我累得要命，只好明天再整理後院了。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān guāng shì zhěnglǐ qiányuàn de huācǎo shùmù jiù ràng wǒ lèi de yàomìng, zhǐhǎo míngtiān zài zhěnglǐ hòuyuàn le.
examples.english: Today, just tidying up the flowers, plants, and trees in the front yard made me extremely tired, so I'll have to do the backyard tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 開車時不闖紅燈，是為了自己和別人的生命安全。
examples.pinyin: Kāichē shí bù chuǎng hóngdēng, shì wèile zìjǐ hé biérén de shēngmìng ānquán.
examples.english: Not running red lights when driving is for the safety of your own and others' lives.

examples.chinese: 經過這次手術，得了重病的嬰兒終於順利地保住了生命。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò zhè cì shǒushù, dé le zhòngbìng de yīng'ér zhōngyú shùnlì de bǎo zhù le shēngmìng.
examples.english: After this surgery, the seriously ill baby finally had its life successfully protected.

examples.chinese: 在歷史上，每次革命都對社會造成非常大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Zài lìshǐ shàng, měi cì gémìng dōu duì shèhuì zàochéng fēicháng dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In history, every revolution has had a very great impact on society.

examples.chinese: 自從開始掉頭髮以後，醫師就建議他每天吃半顆維他命。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng kāishǐ diào tóufa yǐhòu, yīshī jiù jiànyì tā měitiān chī bàn kē wéitāmìng.
examples.english: Ever since he started losing hair, the doctor has suggested he take half a vitamin pill every day.

examples.chinese: 戰爭雖然勝利了，這個國家卻也失去了許多寶貴的生命。
examples.pinyin: Zhànzhēng suīrán shènglì le, zhè ge guójiā què yě shīqù le xǔduō bǎoguì de shēngmìng.
examples.english: Although the war was won, this country also lost many precious lives.

examples.chinese: 他看了歷史電影後，就非常崇拜戰爭中的革命英雄。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn le lìshǐ diànyǐng hòu, jiù fēicháng chóngbài zhànzhēng zhōng de gémìng yīngxióng.
examples.english: After he watched a historical movie, he greatly adored the revolutionary heroes in the war.

examples.chinese: 她推動學習革命，讓學生主動參與規劃課程。
examples.pinyin: Tā tuīdòng xuéxí gémìng, ràng xuéshēng zhǔdòng cānyǔ guīhuà kèchéng.
examples.english: She promoted a learning revolution, letting students actively participate in planning the curriculum.

examples.chinese: 生命中每一刻都很珍貴，隨時多用點心、多付出，就能令人生更美好。
examples.pinyin: Shēngmìng zhōng měi yī kè dōu hěn zhēnguì, suíshí duō yòng diǎn xīn, duō fùchū, jiù néng lìng rénshēng gèng měihǎo.
examples.english: Every moment in life is precious; always put in a little more effort and give a little more, and you can make life more beautiful.

examples.chinese: 關於生命的意義，每個人的想法都不同。
examples.pinyin: Guānyú shēngmìng de yìyì, měi gè rén de xiǎngfǎ dōu bùtóng.
examples.english: Regarding the meaning of life, everyone's thoughts are different.

examples.chinese: 他不小心摔壞了新買的手機，因此難過得要命。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn shuāihuài le xīn mǎi de shǒujī, yīncǐ nánguò de yàomìng.
examples.english: He accidentally dropped and broke his newly bought cell phone, so he was extremely upset.

items.wordHook: A 亼(gather) of people bow low in 叩(kowtow) to ask for a 命(life).

examples.chinese: 客人都抵達婚禮現場了，新娘卻還沒開始化妝，太誇張了！
examples.pinyin: Kèrén dōu dǐdá hūnlǐ xiànchǎng le, xīnniáng què hái méi kāishǐ huàzhuāng, tài kuāzhāng le!
examples.english: The guests have all arrived at the wedding venue, but the bride hasn't even started putting on makeup yet—that's too outrageous!

examples.chinese: 那位新郎的歲數比新娘大十五歲，可是兩人看起來一樣年輕。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi xīnláng de suìshù bǐ xīnniáng dà shíwǔ suì, kěshì liǎng rén kàn qǐlái yīyàng niánqīng.
examples.english: That groom's age is fifteen years older than the bride's, but the two of them look equally young.

examples.chinese: 這次活動大家都化裝參加，要是你碰見我大概認不出我是誰。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng dàjiā dōu huàzhuāng cānjiā, yàoshi nǐ pèngjiàn wǒ dàgài rèn bù chū wǒ shì shéi.
examples.english: Everyone is attending this event in disguise; if you run into me, you probably won't recognize who I am.

examples.chinese: 化裝舞會上他打扮成一具機器人，連說話走路都模仿機器人。
examples.pinyin: Huàzhuāng wǔhuì shàng tā dǎbàn chéng yī jù jīqìrén, lián shuōhuà zǒulù dōu mófǎng jīqìrén.
examples.english: At the masquerade ball, he dressed up as a robot, even imitating a robot when speaking and walking.

items.wordHook: a 冂(frame) rests around 一(one) open space → the speaking 口(mouth).
對面 means across from. 對(facing) + 面(side) → the side facing you.
Combining 性(sex) and 格(form): 性格 means character, personality.
Cut the 角(horn) with a 刀(knife) to dissect the 牛(ox) — 解(explain).
A 金(gold) 勺(spoon) dangles as bait to catch a fish → 釣(fish).
